checks.message: All required files present. proposal.md uses format_version 2 and bilingual_contract_version 1. All GeoJSON features have required properties.

Proposal text includes source, standard, depth, data, and metric references. All 6 agent tasks and 3 announcement tasks covered. 5 mandatory professional standards addressed. All 15 design depth items marked complete.
All GeoJSON features use valid source_type and geometry_role enum values. Provisional boundaries disclosed. Polygons closed and non-self-intersecting. Land use partition covers site boundary.
visual/index.html is static offline HTML with no CDN or remote resources. report/proposal.html is complete HTML with local figure references. 5 evidence figures embedded in proposal.md.
Provisional boundaries fully disclosed. Not misrepresented as official redline. Marked provisional_constraint.
GeoJSON, metrics, five figures, HTML, and PDFs use same generated data. All manifest file sha256 checksums verified.
Proposal text, sources, assumptions, HTML, and figures all disclose accuracy limits. Area recalculation pending official data release.
AI Agent generation toolchain disclosed. Public data references marked with source and license. No unauthorized images or trademarks used.
12 medical AI scenarios have risk boundaries. 3 test scenarios follow tiered validation. High-impact steps require human review.
